description: Expanded from 10 to 12 managers in 2023. Buy-in increased from $20 to $50 around the same period.
10-man era. 4-team playoff. Matchups were 2 weeks each with no bye weeks.
12-man era. 6-team playoff. Top 2 seeds get a 1-week bye. Semis and Finals are 2-week matchups.
Snake draft format. Always includes an in-person component with a rotating annual location.
The 'Sacko' (last place) is required to complete a public humiliation task, though enforcement has been inconsistent since 2020.
